name: the 345 hoodie
placement: front chest mark, message on back
intro: the first 345 piece and still the one most people reach for. a classic heavyweight hoodie, cotton-faced and soft inside, with the 3 | 4 | 5 mark small on the chest and the full message across the back.
message: 3 | 4 | 5 is more than clothing. it is a message.
for the moments when words go unsaid, this is a way to say: i love you. i believe in you. i am proud of you.
a quiet reminder that someone is thinking of you, or a daily nudge to speak what we often keep inside.
love yours.
note: this piece carries the 3 | 4 | 5 message on the back, a way to say what we don't always say out loud. the hope is that one day it is understood, and doesn't need to be written at all.
know: unisex fit, true to size
machine wash cold, hang dry to protect the embroidery
made to order, one at a time, by our print partner printful
ships from the us, usually 5 to 9 business days door to door
wrong size or a flaw in the print: send us a note from the support page within 30 days and we will make it right
